title: Ram-Ram Sa: A Greeting the Hand Can Make
label: ch:mw-ram-ram-sa
canDo: I can recognise, read, say, copy, and write the respectful Marwadi greeting राम-राम सा, and answer it with the same greeting.

payoff.summary: A two-line authentic greeting exchange followed by independent written recall, using only signs and language taught in the chapter.
